description: "Refused with 409 package-already-loaded (ErrPackageAlreadyLoaded) if the tracking number is on another OPEN or CLOSED load, and with 409 load-over-capacity (ErrLoadOverCapacity) if the load would exceed its capacity snapshot. On a LINEHAUL or AIR departure the package is also booked on the departure (gap G15): 409 departure-full or departure-closed when it cannot be. On a PICKUP departure the booking was made at FulfillmentLocked and booked does not change. Adding a tracking number that is already on this load changes nothing."

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/loads/{loadId}/packages"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Refused with 409 package-already-loaded (ErrPackageAlreadyLoaded) if the tracking number is on another OPEN or CLOSED load, and with 409 load-over-capacity (ErrLoadOverCapacity) if the load would exceed its capacity snapshot. On a LINEHAUL or AIR departure the package is also booked on the departure (gap G15): 409 departure-full or departure-closed when it cannot be. On a PICKUP departure the booking was made at FulfillmentLocked and booked does not change. Adding a tracking number that is already on this load changes nothing.
